subject: christian-religious-education
general_outcomes: Demonstrate an awareness of God as a loving father and sole Creator by following His teachings.
Recognize the Bible as a Holy Book by respecting it and living by its teachings.
Apply the teachings of Jesus Christ in his/her interaction with others to form harmonious relationships.
Utilise Christian values and principles to make informed moral decisions in day-to-day life.
Recognise the role of the church in transforming the lives of both young and old people in the society.
Utilise digital devices and social media platforms appropriately for responsible living.
Desire to be God fearing Christians who are spiritually, intellectually and morally sound.

core competencies and the nurturing of various values. The teacher is expected to vary the core competencies and values emphasised in the activity yearly.
